mapper.insert: INSERT INTO storage_switch_state (id, active_version) VALUES (1, 1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE storage_switch_state SET pending_version = active_version + 1, pending_config_id = #{targetConfigId}, pending_platform = #{targetPlatform}, pending_time = statement_timestamp(), pending_token = replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), expected_instances = #{expectedInstances}, update_time = statement_timestamp() WHERE id = 1 AND pending_version IS NULL

UPDATE storage_switch_state SET active_version = pending_version, pending_version = NULL, pending_config_id = NULL, pending_platform = NULL, pending_time = NULL, pending_token = NULL, expected_instances = 1, update_time = statement_timestamp() WHERE id = 1 AND pending_version = #{version}

UPDATE storage_switch_state SET pending_version = NULL, pending_config_id = NULL, pending_platform = NULL, pending_time = NULL, pending_token = NULL, expected_instances = 1, update_time = statement_timestamp() WHERE id = 1 AND pending_version IS NOT NULL
